cyd32-st7798.title: SquachEmit v1.1.0 CYD 3.2 — 172 Synthetic Signals + Device-First Names
cyd32-st7798.summary: Public v1.1.0 firmware for CYD 3.2 ST7798: 172 synthetic BLE/Wi-Fi test cases including 27 UAS vendor-prefix beacons, saved 3–30-second TX-time editor, reduced touchscreen flashing, and animated Squachy. Browser installer verifies all four flash segments by SHA-256. Actual CYD hardware was flashed during development; no device certification. Draft PR #36 displays recognizable per-scenario device names in the native test library, active signal and selected status. Original RUN IDs, payloads and receiver categories stay unchanged.
highlights: Device-first labels on all 172 transmitter signals, including Flipper Zero UUID/name, negative controls and manufacturer OUI cases; stable technical IDs preserved.
172 bounded synthetic BLE/Wi-Fi scenarios; per-case locally administered MAC IDs.
TX TIME [SET] with +/- 1 second, RESET 12 and DONE; persists after reboot.
Routine touches and duration changes avoid unnecessary full-screen redraws.
STOP, SUITE and transmit auto-timeout remain.
Installer verifies bootloader, partition table, OTA selector and application.
Manufacturer-only prefixes do not authenticate a real drone.

c5-waveshare-28.title: SquachEmit v1.1.0 Waveshare C5 — 172 Signals + Device-First Names
c5-waveshare-28.summary: Public v1.1.0 firmware for the exact Waveshare ESP32-C5 2.8-inch touchscreen board: 172 synthetic BLE/Wi-Fi test cases including UAV vendor-prefix beacons, controlled RF tests, and SHA-256 verified browser flashing. CYD 3.2-only TX TIME screen is not a C5 feature. Build passes CI; physical C5 hardware verification is still required. Draft PR #36 adds uppercase recognizable device-first names in the native C5 test list and active signal while retaining exact technical IDs.
highlights: Native list names all 172 synthetic signals by device; case IDs remain below each label.
172 shared detection cases and negative controls.
27 UAV vendor Wi-Fi test beacons; no genuine drone RF claim.
Controlled, time-limited tests with serial truth reporting.
Four-part SHA-256 preflight, including C5 bootloader at 0x2000.
Requires exact Waveshare C5 2.8-inch touch hardware.

s3-devkit.title: SquachEmit v1.1.0 ESP32-S3 — 172-Case Serial Test Suite
s3-devkit.summary: Public v1.1.0 firmware for ESP32-S3 DevKitC-1 with 172 synthetic BLE/Wi-Fi detection test cases, on-demand serial RUN/STOP/SUITE control, UAV vendor-prefix test scenarios, and SHA-256 verified browser flashing. No CYD touchscreen is included. Build passes CI; physical S3 hardware verification is still required.
highlights: 172 shared synthetic scenarios and negative controls.
USB serial RUN, STOP and SUITE for bounded transmitter tests.
Vendor OUI-only beacons are not authentic aircraft broadcasts.
No CYD touchscreen interface is claimed for S3.
